items.explanation: A **term** is a part of the school year: *semestr*. A **term** is also a word with a special meaning in a subject: *pojem*.
items.explanation_cz: **term** = část školního roku (*semestr*). Taky = *pojem / odborný výraz* v oboru.

intro.title: You already know
intro.note: Not new — you met these before. You will see them again here.

intro.title: You will use these words in
intro.note: maths is the short British word for mathematics. American English shortens it to math, with no s.
intro.note_cz: maths = mathematics (britsky). Americky math, bez s.
